summary: launchpad is on sale. Point it at your app and it gets it live, secure and measured.
notes: Activate your key once: launchpad downloads the full product for your version and checks its signature before it runs.
Mission Control shows every app on one screen: the one next step, builds, testers, uptime, traffic, crashes and costs.
iPhone apps build on your own Mac and reach TestFlight, and launchpad drafts your App Store listing for you to approve.
Web apps and sites deploy on every push, set up so search engines and AI assistants can find them.
A key works on two machines and keeps working offline. You choose when to update; it never updates itself.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
